sourceRefs.locator: Namur copy R6A.0608. Printed p. 96, digitised page 119: Annuli aurei, middle row; p. 322, digitised page 348: insects with and without eyes, arranged in alternating orientations. Title and imprint: Antwerp, 1655.
Catalogue essay by Olivier Latteur (January 2025), “Contenu”, paragraphs on the 1653 construction site, Chifflet’s medical career, the Plantin-Moretus edition and the Habsburg–Bourbon argument.

summary.de: Die bei Plantin-Moretus in Antwerpen gedruckte Untersuchung bewahrt Ansichten des verschollenen Siegelrings.
summary.en: Printed by Plantin-Moretus in Antwerp, the study preserves views of the lost seal ring.
